crossRefs.note: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told to you that you would never see it again.…
The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire?…
For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations…
They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues…
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.

translations.web: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
translations.bsb: You will be driven mad by the sights you see.
translations.kjv: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
translations.asv: so that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
